lines.1: 「Hee-hee. I couldn't stand the thought of being late by only a hair, so I resorted to a forbidden move.」
lines.2: 「Sticking out your tongue and playing cute will not work on me.」
lines.3: 「Knowing you, Princess, I am sure no one else saw you. That still does not make this behavior acceptable.」
lines.4: 「Oh. So it really is against the rules?」
lines.5: 「Rules are rules. Even for the Princess--no, especially as student council president, you must set an example.」
lines.6: 「Sato, you must educate the Princess properly as well.」
lines.7: 「Urgh... I objected as hard as I could, but Ellie ran off without waiting for me.」
lines.10: 「All right, I surrender. I'll go to the front gate and file a proper tardy report.」
lines.11: 「Hee-hee. You and Ellie are like the old retainer and the shogun in a period drama.」
lines.12: 「'Your Highness, you simply cannot behave so,' is that it? Whenever I see those scenes, I understand exactly how the retainer feels. It is enough to give one an ulcer.」
lines.13: 「Hm? I don't watch period dramas, so I don't get it.」
lines.14: 「But I might like being called 'Your Highness.'」
lines.15: 「...Homeroom will begin if you do not hurry.」
lines.18: 「Very well. Be more careful from now on.」
lines.22: 「Good grief, what a commotion... Second-years certainly have energy.」
lines.23: 「Hey, some mornings are just like that.」
lines.25: 「Well? I look pretty sharp, don't I?」
lines.26: 「Wearing sunglasses on school grounds is a violation.」
lines.29: 「Good grief. Is his owner late again...?」
lines.30: 「Even Ellie can't defy Otome, can she?」
lines.31: 「Of course not. I was completely in the wrong this time.」
lines.32: 「Still, I find that integrity reassuring. Otome is exactly the kind of person we need.」
